items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I played a couple of pieces with him, you know

ctx.x: Did you work with Bechet much? Did you play banjo with Bechet?

Did you work with Bechet any? Bass? Sidney Bechet. Sidney, no, I was just, I was playing mandolin then. I played a couple of pieces with him, you know, with Tyence Williams, you know, in Peron. Remember Victor Ball? Yeah, yeah. Rampard and Hobbs Avenue. But you see, it's good, and work out with them sometimes, in Henle-Raw. I remember Victor Ball was a lovely Rampard. Yeah. Victor Ball? Victor Ball. It had to be good. Victor Ball. It had to be good to work out with them fellas, you know. Just another one of them…

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: He's talking about Cindy B.K. B.K.

ctx.x: Asking who the good clarinet players were. Now? Yeah.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: Piano, manolene, violin, and sax. That was Cindy Bessier.

ctx.x: Who did he play with? Just some fellas down there. I wasn't playing music then, you know. He'd play class, you know, victory balls, you know. All of them trunks, you know. I don't know. I could play manolene a little bit. The amount that I learned good when I used to play with Clarence Williams, you know. Piano, manolene, violin, and sax. That was Cindy Bessier. Yeah, he was, Cindy was a good thing. Cindy was a good thing. Cindy used to play with anybody too. You know, when he was cold out. Yeah, he didn't have…
He's trying to make the sax. He's a drummer.
